messages:
kai: Heads up — forecasting pipeline's GPU-hours error jumped ~28% yesterday. Metrics look off for us-east-1. Anyone seen related alerts?

nina: seeing gaps in usage-events topic around 2026-03-11 02:00-04:30 UTC. consumer lag spiked to >10k messages.

sam: I ran a quick backfill check. late-arriving events exist but a recent dedupe change may have dropped them. suspect PR #2145.

ashley: PR 2145 was to drop duplicate events for the billing consumer to reduce billing noise — could be too aggressive. pinging @devon who owns billing-consumer.

devon: on it. quick look shows the dedupe rule now rejects events when user_id IS NULL (previously kept). pushing small patch to skip null-user dedupe.

kai: :thumbsup: Once patched can we re-run the ingest/backfill for 03/10-03/12? Need updated GPU-hour projections for capacity planning meeting.

infra-bot: deploy/consumer-billing v1.12.3 rolled back by devon at 1823457005

nina: FYI new ingest-runner exposes metrics ingestion.lag.max and ingestion.null_user.rate — added to dashboard but thresholds not set yet.

sam: query I used to validate missing data:
```sql
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour, count(*) AS events, sum(case when user_id IS NULL then 1 else 0 end) nulls
FROM usage_events
WHERE ts between '2026-03-10' and '2026-03-12'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1;
```

ashley: cost impact estimate: missing ~18k GPU-hours -> ~$12k/month on projected workload if not corrected. adding to finance sync agenda.

devon: deployed fix, reprocessed backlog, starting forecast recalculation now. ETA ~45m.

kai: thanks. after recalculation, please push updated dashboard to forecasting/gpu-hours and annotate incident on 2026-03-11 (ingest gap).

nina: will add annotation + set alerting threshold: ingestion.null_user.rate > 0.5% -> page.

sam: long-term note: add integration test that runs dedupe rules against synthesized null-user events to prevent regression.

kai: agreed. create ticket and I'll add acceptance criteria: 'no >10% drift in daily GPU-hours after ingest' for the forecast pipeline.

devon: created infra ticket INF-862, linking PR + backfill run logs: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-862

infra-bot: backfill job 'ingest-reprocess-20260311' completed at 1823457200, processed 54,123 events

ashley: :eyes: I'll update the finance slide deck and note the annotation. thx y'all
